evidence.why: Shows the exact input field, priority, destinations and callback operations.
Defines delegated article and effect cleanup.

facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline's held-input and x668 description to the canonical pressed_buttons field while preserving branch priority and outputs.
facts.value: After the common escape check declines the action, reads Fighter.input.pressed_buttons. Pressed HSD_PAD_B selects literal motion state 346 and refreshes Samus's damage/death callbacks. Otherwise pressed HSD_PAD_LR selects literal 345, removes the held Charge Shot representation and guarded fighter effects, and refreshes those callbacks. A successful common escape check bypasses both local button tests and performs cleanup.

evidence.why: Complete signature, Fighter lookup and pressed-button tests.

facts.rationale: Preserves the supported signature and argument role while correcting held input to pressed input.
facts.value: Fighter IASA callback with signature void(HSD_GObj* gobj). Its argument identifies Samus's fighter object; the callback resolves its Fighter and reads the pressed controller-button bitmask for its local fire and cancel tests.

evidence.why: Complete guard ladder, early return and fallthrough.

facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline's held-button guards without changing its supported escape-before-B-before-LR ordering.
facts.value: In grounded Charge Shot Hold, a successful common escape check takes precedence and invokes cleanup. Otherwise pressed B selects literal state 346, refreshes damage/death callbacks and returns. Only when B is absent can pressed LR select literal state 345, invoke cleanup and refresh callbacks. If none of these conditions applies, this callback requests no transition.

evidence.why: Entry writes and downstream uses of x0 and x4.

facts.rationale: Removes the unsupported classification of both x4 and x8 as counters while retaining the entry routine's supported behavior.
facts.value: Enters and initializes Samus's grounded Charge Shot startup: selects literal motion state 343, clears all four command variables, invokes grounded-state setup, zeros vertical velocity, refreshes damage/death callbacks, and clears mv.ss.unk3.x0, x4 and x8 before animation processing. Subsequent startup logic uses x0 as a routing selector and holding uses x4 as a charge-step timer; this unit establishes only that x8 is reset, not that it is a counter.
